name: BACH_0107_FSIM_resample3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (94%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Degraded simulated frozen section (severity-3 resample) fails reliability checks, models disagree, and margin call defers to permanent sections [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 94%, InSitu 5%, Benign 1%, Normal 0% (ECE 5%, CI 4–22%) [F1] | High invasive risk score |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% target (alpha 10%; test coverage 90%, n=132) | Single class; dataset-level guarantee only |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 44% (flagged), OOD 100th percentile (12 tiles; AUROC 70%) [F6] | Suspect degraded input; low reliability |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class (false) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Invasive (3 Normal, 2 Benign; 76–79% similarity) [F5] | All five neighbors are non-invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 9) · context · Below-typical score (z=-0.66, contribution +0.39); descriptive only (8/20 check) [F2] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules (z=-0.64, contribution +0.30; caption mismatch, 18/20 check) [F3] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Low duct-confinement score (z=-1.05, contribution +0.29; 12/20 check) [F4] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (z=-0.24, contribution +0.29), failed 0/20 AI check · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · High embedding score (z=+1.34, contribution +0.23; 18/20 AI check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing 3 top-risk regions drops invasive probability versus random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and mitoses (0/20, weak).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 resampling and simulated frozen-section artifacts mimic nuclear atypia; recut H&E and deeper levels are drafted to verify.
- Tissue is Benign or Normal like all 5 nearest neighbors (76–79% similarity), including contrast case BACH_0302 (Benign).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 1, 8, 2**: Highest risk (99–100%); confirm stromal invasion (region 4) versus frozen-section artifact.
2. **Regions 0, 9, 11**: Verify nuclear pleomorphism and duct confinement; discount unreliable mitoses and lobule scores.
3. **Regions 6, 3, 7**: Check lower-risk regions (7–35%) for preserved tubules (region 6) and benign stroma.
